name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Ransomware claims up 26% in October; US hospital systems disrupted
state: Ransomware leak-site claims rose 25.8% to 1,127 in October (HackerFeeds, 31 Oct), peaking on 26 Oct. University Hospitals (Cleveland) websites and portals were still down on 29 Oct after an incident, and a group claimed an attack on University of New Mexico hospitals (26 Oct); the university says core systems were not breached.
for_you: Be alert to phishing that exploits high-profile incidents. The NCSC publishes guidance for individuals and businesses.
rubric_hit: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.

sources.title: Tech Insider — Ransomware attacks October 2026: 1,127 claims
Ideastream — Most University Hospitals websites still down

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
